Resistance and Vulnerability often mislead players - damage is halved or doubled, not subtracted or added.

DMs: Remind players that Resistance and Vulnerability modify total damage, not individual dice - page 16 has the details.

Send this to the rules-lawyer in your group. @bizzalgames70

Control Ice alters the battlefield more than it deals damage - range is 20' per caster level.

Judges: Use Control Ice's 20' per caster level range to preemptively block escape routes, not just for flashy damage.

Send this to the rules-lawyer in your group. @bizzalgames70

Sword Of The Ancients isn't just a +2 longsword - it can be summoned across the plane.

GMs: Remind them to summon the Sword Of The Ancients when disarmed or trapped, not just to start a fight.

Ran it differently at your table? Drop it in the comments. @bizzalgames70

Mummy earns its stakes fast.

DMs: When players ignore the Mummy's Dreadful Glare, remind them that failing a DC 11 Wisdom save means paralysis - then watch the panic.

Save this for your next session. Daily rulings: @bizzalgames70

Siege Colossus pressures parties with overwhelming force - 3d24 action dice and attacks that knock prone.

Judges: Place the Siege Colossus where its 500' range ballista can punish the party's predictable clustering and lack of cover.

Save this for your next session. Daily rulings: @bizzalgames70

Dying and Death confuses tables over survival checks - DC 15 CON check determines survival.

GMs: Enforce the DC 15 CON check for dying characters and ensure allies remember the DC 12 WIS check to stabilize.

One ruling a day, no fluff. Follow @bizzalgames70.

Wand of Polymorph changes encounters more than players expect - save DC 15 forces tough decisions.

DMs: Save the Wand of Polymorph's charges for when a single DC 15 save can turn the tide of battle.

Send this to the rules-lawyer in your group. @bizzalgames70

Corruption surprises wizards with its permanence - a natural 1 on a spell check means the spell is lost.

Judges: Remind wizards that a natural 1 on spell checks means permanent spell loss and irreversible corruption - plan accordingly.

Save this for your next session. Daily rulings: @bizzalgames70

Bogthorn's thorn hail is more dangerous than its stab attack - poison with DC 12 CON or paralyze for 1d4.

GMs: Use Bogthorn's thorn hail to paralyze and isolate targets; players, stay out of its near range or face the consequences.

Send this to the rules-lawyer in your group. @bizzalgames70

Temporary Hit Points absorb damage before actual Hit Points - they vanish first when you take damage.

DMs: Remind players that Temporary Hit Points absorb the first 17 damage before real Hit Points, and they don't stack.

Ran it differently at your table? Drop it in the comments. @bizzalgames70

Dwarves can't be wizards - their racial class identity locks them into martial roles.

Judges: Position your Dwarf to use Shield Brother for +2 AC, reinforcing allies instead of chasing higher damage.

Save this for your next session. Daily rulings: @bizzalgames70

Thief shifts from setup to closer - Backstab makes the pivot with a single attack roll.

GMs: Have the Thief roll for Backstab early, while enemies are unaware, to exploit double damage before chaos ensues.
